entries.title: So many fine qualities
entries.literal_meaning: The quiet one has boundless qualities.
entries.explanation: The praise turns on the dictionary’s explicitly ironic definition: apparently quiet, yet scheming. “Qualities” therefore carries a sting rather than straightforward admiration. Our critical reading keeps that insinuation audible while questioning it: silence alone cannot establish deceit. This response is ours, not a tolerant lesson hidden in the source.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ୍ୟ ଅର୍ଥ—ବାହାରକୁ ଚୁପ୍, ଭିତରେ କପଟ—ପ୍ରଶଂସାର ସ୍ୱରକୁ ଓଲଟାଇ ଦିଏ। ତେଣୁ “ଗୁଣ” କଥାରେ ସରଳ ପ୍ରଶଂସା ବଦଳେ ଖୋଚା ରହେ। ଆମ ସମାଲୋଚନାତ୍ମକ ପଢ଼ା ସେ ଇଙ୍ଗିତକୁ ରଖି ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ: କେବଳ ଚୁପ୍ ରହିବା କପଟର ପ୍ରମାଣ ହୋଇପାରେନାହିଁ। ଏହି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ଆମର; ଉତ୍ସର ଗୁପ୍ତ ସହନଶୀଳ ଶିକ୍ଷା ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Ironic praise conceals an accusation that our reading questions.
entries.odia_summary: ବ୍ୟଙ୍ଗ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଶଂସାର ଅଭିଯୋଗକୁ ଆମ ପଢ଼ା ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରେ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ବୈଠକରେ ଜଣେ ସଦସ୍ୟ କମ୍ କଥା କହିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ଢଗଟି ଉଠାଇଲେ। ସଭାପତି କହିଲେ, “ଚୁପ୍ ଥିଲେ ବୋଲି ସନ୍ଦେହ କରିବା କାହିଁକି? ତାଙ୍କ ମତ ଶୁଣିବା।” / A member speaks little at a meeting. Someone invokes the line. The chair replies, “Why suspect them for being quiet? Let us hear their view.” This exchange is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The head lists a feminine form matching the quotation. Its broad claim about quiet people is a historical dictionary judgment, not evidence about a gender or personality type.

entries.title: The boat of dharma
entries.literal_meaning: The boat of dharma travels happily.
entries.explanation: The entry places the line under following the religious path, then gives the literal boat sense. Its note records a belief that dharma keeps boats afloat. Read as an image of faith, the journey offers reassurance. Our interpretation preserves that confidence as a belief, without turning it into a physical promise of safety.
entries.meaning_odia: ଅଭିଧାନ ଧର୍ମପଥ ଅନୁସରଣ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଢଗଟି ରଖି ପରେ ପ୍ରକୃତ ନୌକାର ଅର୍ଥ ଦିଏ। ଟୀକାରେ ଧର୍ମ ଥିବାରୁ ଡଙ୍ଗା ଭାସୁଛି ବୋଲି ଏକ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଲିପିବଦ୍ଧ। ଆସ୍ଥାର ଛବି ଭାବେ ପଢ଼ିଲେ ଯାତ୍ରାଟି ଆଶ୍ୱାସ ଦିଏ। ଆମ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା ସେ ଭରସାକୁ ବିଶ୍ୱାସ ଭାବେ ରଖେ, ପ୍ରକୃତ ଯାତ୍ରାର ନିରାପତ୍ତା ପ୍ରତିଶ୍ରୁତି କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: A boat image expresses religious confidence, not a safety guarantee.
entries.odia_summary: ଡଙ୍ଗାର ଛବିରେ ଧାର୍ମିକ ଭରସା, ନିରାପତ୍ତାର ନିଶ୍ଚୟତା ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ପଢ଼ାଚକ୍ରରେ ଜଣେ ଢଗଟିକୁ ନିଜ ଆସ୍ଥାର କଥା ଭାବେ କହିଲେ। ଅନ୍ୟଜଣ ପଚାରିଲେ, “ଏଠି ଡଙ୍ଗାଟି ତୁମ ପାଇଁ କଣ?” ସେ କହିଲେ, “କଠିନ କାମରେ ଭରସା ରଖିବାର ଛବି।” / In a reading group, someone uses the saying to express faith. Asked what the boat means to them, they answer, “An image of keeping confidence through difficult work.” The exchange is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The recorded belief is attributed to this dictionary witness; its prevalence, present practice and theological reach were not independently established. No navigation instruction or claim that faith prevents drowning follows.

entries.title: Your gaze has changed
entries.literal_meaning: Earlier, Kāḷiā, you refused on seeing the runny nose; now, Kāḷiā, you pine away on seeing breasts and youth.
entries.explanation: The same addressee is called twice, first for rejection and then for longing. The bodily contrast exposes a change in response. Our reading asks what such a reversal reveals about the observer’s standards, rather than treating a person’s worth as dependent on youthful appearance. The source does not identify the speaker, exact ages or relationship.
entries.meaning_odia: ଏକା ଲୋକକୁ ଦୁଇଥର ଡକାଯାଇଛି—ଆଗେ ନାହିଁ କରିବା ପାଇଁ, ଏବେ ଝୁରିବା ପାଇଁ। ଦେହକୁ ନେଇ ବିରୋଧଟି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାର ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତନ ଦେଖାଏ। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ ଏହି ଓଲଟାଣି ଦେଖୁଥିବା ଲୋକର ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ ନେଇ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ ଉଠାଏ; ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟକୁ ଯୌବନର ଦେଖାଶୁଣା ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରାଏନାହିଁ। ବକ୍ତା, ନିର୍ଦ୍ଦିଷ୍ଟ ବୟସ ବା ସମ୍ପର୍କ ଉତ୍ସ ଚିହ୍ନାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: A changed bodily response prompts our question about the observer’s standards.
entries.odia_summary: ଦେହ ଦେଖି ବଦଳିଥିବା ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟାରେ ଦର୍ଶକର ମାନଦଣ୍ଡକୁ ନେଇ ଆମ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ।
